page.notes: The quotation marks « in the right margin (lines 6 to 9) are printed marks, transcribed as notes at their places. Line 1 opens with a fragment ("periem,") and stays one. Line 9, "sentiri", is doubtful: the first letter looks like a long s or l, so it is marked [?]. Printed spellings such as "quód", "quę" and "Fernelij" are kept as they stand. The running head is set in spaced capitals, read as CAVSAS, PROGYMNASMATA.
